rv.q: All this is delightfully handled by Kirsty McDuff and Chris Forbes in a light-footed production by Liz Carruthers.
With a solid script and wonderful performances, this makes for an extremely entertaining play.

cn.t: Critics find Donahoe's play about the infamous Anna Anderson impostor entertaining and well-crafted, praising its exploration of delusion and identity through a compelling interrogation room setup.
